episodes.title: Mac and Dennis: Manhunters
episodes.summary: Charlie and Dee have been stealing Frank's delicious meats, so Frank leaves out human meat to get back at them. Driven by their cannibalistic needs, Charlie and Dee go in search of human flesh.

episodes.title: The Gang Solves the Gas Crisis
episodes.summary: Charlie, Mac, and Dennis formulate a plan to take advantage of the rising gas prices. By purchasing excess amounts now, they can sell it in the future and profit. As usual, things don't go as planned.

episodes.title: America’s Next Top Paddy’s Billboard Model Contest
episodes.summary: Due to the gang's latest "business expenses," Paddy's is in dire need of money. Frank buys a billboard to advertise the bar, but Dee decides to create a viral video to post on YouTube for promotion.

episodes.title: Mac’s Banging the Waitress
episodes.summary: Charlie finds out that the waitress has been seeing someone. He calls on Mac, his so-called best friend, to find out more information about the guy and to beat him up.

episodes.title: Mac and Charlie Die (1)
episodes.summary: Part 1 of 2. Mac and Charlie fake their deaths to avoid the wrath of Mac's father who was released from prison and is out for vengeance.

episodes.title: Mac and Charlie Die (2)
episodes.summary: Part 2 of 2. Dennis, Frank, and Dee find unique ways of coping with the apparent loss of their friends.

episodes.title: Who Pooped the Bed?
episodes.summary: Charlie and Frank awake to find poop in their bed. Neither will confess to being the owner, so they, Mac, and Dennis try to scientifically deduce who dropped the deuce.

episodes.title: Paddy’s Pub: The Worst Bar in Philadelphia
episodes.summary: A newspaper critic is kidnapped by the gang after he calls Paddy's pub the worst bar in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Dennis Reynolds: An Erotic Life
episodes.summary: After discovering Dennis' erotic memoir, Mac and Frank attempt to make some money off of it. Meanwhile, Dee and Charlie decide to spend a day in each other's shoes.

episodes.title: Sweet Dee Has a Heart Attack
episodes.summary: After Dee suffers a heart attack, she and Dennis try to live a healthier lifestyle. Meanwhile, Charlie and Mac take corporate jobs to get health insurance.

episodes.title: The Gang Cracks the Liberty Bell
episodes.summary: The gang fudge history by claiming that Paddy's Pub was responsible for cracking the Liberty Bell in an attempt to turn their dive into a Philadelphia landmark.

episodes.title: The Gang Gets Extreme: Home Makeover Edition
episodes.summary: Hoping to make their own dreams come true, the gang sets out to give an unexpected family an extreme home makeover.

episodes.title: The Nightman Cometh
episodes.summary: In the season finale, Charlie gets the gang to help him put together a rock opera based on his song "Nightman."
